messages:
elaine: Heads-up 1: AWS Marketplace intake window is coming up. Partner security asked for a joint blurb covering SSO (SAML), SCIM, and KMS/HSM support. Need a quick plan + owners.
kai: I can take the SAML/SCIM/KMS technical spec. Will include sample metadata and key policy.
maya: Product asks for a customer journey doc: hosted vs dedicated vs private for SSO + BYOK. Also a simple matrix for feature availability by plan.
shaun: Legal wants an announcement-safe sentence set and a compliance checklist (dont claim FedRAMP etc). I'll draft the release wording.
liam: Marketplace side: AWS wants a short security summary, 3 screenshots, partner contact, and timing. We should coordinate screenshots early.
elaine: Proposed deliverables: (1) Tech spec (kai), (2) Announcement draft (shaun + maya), (3) Marketplace assets (liam), (4) Customer checklist + migration notes (maya). Target: deliver two weeks before intake.
kai: For KMS, plan to show two modes: customer-managed (BYOK: AWS KMS/HSM) and Redwood-managed. I'll add YAML examples and a key rotation note.
maya: Can you provide a one-liner we can reuse in the listing? e.g. "Supports SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning, and optional customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS/HSM)."
shaun: That line looks good but avoid "optional" if it confuses marketplace copy. I'll polish.
liam: marketplace-bizdev-bot: "Listing intake opens 2026-11-05. Required: security summary, 3 screenshots, partner contact. Upload by 2026-11-01."
elaine: Kai, paste a minimal SAML metadata example so docs/screenshots can use it.
kai: Example: <EntityDescriptor entityID=\"https://redwood.example.com/saml\">... <AssertionConsumerService Location=\"https://redwood.example.com/auth/saml/callback\"/> ...</EntityDescriptor>
(note: real tenant metadata generated per-tenant).
maya: SCIMnotes: we support SCIM 2.0 with users + groups, provisioning via bearer token, and attribute mapping. I'll make a mapping table for docs.
shaun: Announcement draft starter: "Redwood now supports enterprise SSO via SAML and customer-managed encryption keys for private deployments." I'll avoid any attestation claims.
liam: I'll prep the listing template and check preferred screenshot dimensions with AWS.
\aiElaine: tiny typo earlier, ignore.
elaine: Thanks. Next steps: kai drop tech draft by EOD Thu, shaun/maya start announcement + checklist, liam pulls screenshot specs and schedules AWS sync. I'll set a 30-min sync with AWS early next week.
kai: Will include a short FAQ about KMS access patterns and a note on KV cache coordination for key rotation in Dedicated.
maya: Add that rotation risk to the customer checklist as mitigation steps.
shaun: Also capturing clear customer-facing wording about key ownership so sales doesn't overpromise.
liam: Meeting invite sent for Mon 09:00 PT with AWS marketplace contact.
marketplace-bizdev-bot: "Reminder: Upload assets to partner portal by 2026-11-01 to meet intake."
elaine: Closing thread unless urgent. :thumbsup:
